reviewProtocol: Same interpolated six saved front-camera positions for all three turn models; lateral +/-4% of endpoint baseline, arbitrary units. Not a measured lane-width test.

observations.observation: 0–5.88s: the street and houses remain recognizable, but the road foreground and roofs are soft.
6–9.88s: porch edges, poles and foreground shapes stretch or double as the viewpoint shifts.
2.00s: distant windows and roof edges are weak; 4.00s porch lines lack separation.
4.00s: conspicuous red-car ghost; 0.00s ghosted barrels and 9.88s transparent foreground clutter.
All eight samples show a connected street, but foreground occlusion and incomplete edges remain.

comparisons: The improved and cleanup versions use the identical review cameras. At 4.00s compare the red-car ghost; at 9.88s compare porch/foreground distortion.
Smallest delivered file does not make this the best driving view. Final full training duration is not logged here; the 19.1-minute near-completion observation is not used as a complete time.
limits: AI-assisted editorial assessment of eight labelled samples per model, with links to the complete 80-sample review and existing native evidence. Not an independent human panel.
No real-time FPS, fine temporal flicker, physical-phone thermal test, surveyed scale or independent novel-view truth measured.
Human effort and end-to-end elapsed time unknown; source-view metrics are not lateral geometric accuracy.
Different captures, routes, training budgets and encodings make cross-group ranking a provisional asset-utility judgment, not an algorithm leaderboard.
